details.summary: Executed with absolute operational precision on a highly aggressive timeline, proving our capacity to manage multiple vendor overlaps and deliver a high-impact commercial environment without schedule overruns.

stages.label: Day 1
stages.title: Raw Shell
stages.description: A bare 4,000 sq. ft. commercial floorplate, structurally surveyed for MEP before a single wall goes up.

stages.label: Day 15
stages.title: Structure & MEP
stages.description: Electrical, HVAC, and acoustic backing routed alongside framing, the phase most turnkey firms let slip.

stages.label: Day 30
stages.title: Finishes
stages.description: Fluted panelling, sprung flooring, and the linear LED grid land, and the studio starts reading as designed space.

stages.label: Day 45
stages.title: Handover
stages.description: Final quality pass against the approved drawing set. Keys handed over on the date signed in the Master Contract.
